At a = 0.1752 au against a conservative inner edge of 0.1769 au it is in the optimistic HZ, warmer side, within 1% of the conservative edge (a boundary case by the Legend's rule). Teklu et al. 2025 (A&A 702, A68, HIRES) not checked. The writer may prefer tier 'strong' on the Unconfirmed tab instead.
